title: Overwatch Patch Notes – January 8, 2019
raw_text: January 8, 2019 Overwatch Patch Notes – January 8, 2019 A new patch is now live on PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a bug that prevented the title text for Ana’s Bastet Challenge from displaying Heroes McCree Fixed a bug that caused McCree’s model to distort if he used Combat Roll to the right with the Sherlock skin equipped
